entities.summary: Chris Tierney is a Canadian professional ice hockey centre who currently plays for HC Ambrì-Piotta in the National League (NL). He was selected in the second round, 55th overall, by the San Jose Sharks in the 2012 NHL entry draft. Tierney has also previously played for the New Jersey Devils, Florida Panthers, Montreal Canadiens and Ottawa Senators.
